newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Telefonica says share offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telefonica says share offer oversubscribed.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana expects the entire institutional tranche of its public share offering to be 2.8 times over-subscribed by the end of Wednesday trading on Wall Street, a spokesman said.
State holding company SEPPa is selling its remaining 20.9 percent stake in the domestic telephone operator.

As of Tuesday's close, the entire institutional tranche of 68,430,721 shares was 2.54 times over-subscribed, spokesman Edward Holland said. Demand for the European tranche was 4.18 times higher than the offer and the Spanish institutional tranche was 5.27 times oversubscribed.
"At this point, we have already surpassed the excess demand at the end of the last public offering," Holland said.
The share sale ends on Friday.
Strong domestic demand allowed the state to boost the retail tranche by 17.1 million shares to 102.65 million this week, thereby reducing the need for placing the rest with foreign institutions.
